thought.text: Let me test the full end-to-end frontend login flow and the /map page.

reasoning_content:
The frontend works and serves pages, redirects to /map (unauthenticated). Let me test an end-to-end login through the frontend to verify auth flow works. Also let me check the frontend /map page and a real login via the frontend proxy.

Let me also test whether the frontend can actually authenticate (the internal API_URL). Let me do a login POST to frontend.

action.command:
cd /tmp
echo "=== frontend login POST ==="; curl -skL --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -c /tmp/fj.txt -b /tmp/fj.txt \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Origin: https://app.localhost" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' \
  https://app.localhost/login -o /dev/null -w "HTTP:%{http_code}\n" 2>&1
echo "cookies:"; grep -i "api-access\|session" /tmp/fj.txt | awk '{print $6}' | head
echo "=== /map after login ==="; curl -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -b /tmp/fj.txt -o /dev/null -w "map:%{http_code}\n" https://app.localhost/map
